name: Refinery utilization minus the pre-2020 median
license: Calculated from US government series stored in this archive
method: WPULEUS3 minus its train median, in percentage points of utilization. Train median 90.40 percent. An anomaly is an absolute deviation at or above the train 90th percentile of absolute deviations, frozen at 7.10 points.

fields.name: Refinery utilization minus the pre-2020 median
